source_text: 98. Telle est, mon cher ami, la prédication de la vérité, et la règle de notre salut; c'est aussi la voie qui mène à la vie. Les prophètes l'ont annoncée, le Christ l'a établie, les Apôtres l'ont transmise, partout dans le monde, l'Église l'offre à ses enfants. En toute assurance, il faut suivre cette voie, avec une volonté saine, afin d'être agréable à Dieu par des œuvres bonnes et le désir sincère d'une conduite parfaite
pass_a_gloss: §98 dual gloss (Armenian-via-French sense) ≠ Pass B running English. Theme: Three heresies vs Father, Son’s flesh, Spirit.
pass_b_english: Hence no one should imagine that God the Father is other than our Creator, as the heretics invent. ([[Isa 44:24 >> Bible:Isa 44:24]]; [[Jn 1:3 >> Bible:Jn 1:3]]) They despise God who is, and make an idol of what is nothing; they forge a father above our Creator, fancying they have found someone greater than the truth. All such are impious and blaspheme their creator and Father, as we showed in the Exposure and overthrow of knowledge falsely so called.

Others disdain the coming of the Son of God and the economy of his incarnation, transmitted by the apostles and foretold by the prophets for humanity’s salvation, as we have briefly shown you. These too must be ranked among unbelievers. ([[1 Jn 4:2-3 >> Bible:1 Jn 4:2-3]]; [[2 Jn 7 >> Bible:2 Jn 7]])

Others do not receive the gifts of the Holy Spirit and push prophetic grace far from them; of them Isaiah said they shall be ‘like a terebinth that has shed its leaves, and like a garden without water’; and those are of no use to God, since they can bring no fruit. ([[Isa 1:30 >> Bible:Isa 1:30]]; [[1 Thess 5:19-20 >> Bible:1 Thess 5:19-20]])
